set.description: Free evening cycling, running and walking on the Yas Marina F1 circuit. Cyclists ride anti-clockwise, walkers and runners go clockwise. Free bikes (adult and kids' sizes) on a first-come basis, or premium rental AED 60 per session; bring your own bike and helmet if you prefer (helmets are mandatory). Register once on the Yas Marina Circuit website and show your QR code from the YMC app. Park in G5/G6 and follow signs to TrainYAS Village. Sessions may change, so check the circuit's website or Instagram before going.
